(3) Notwithstanding the provisions of section 4(1)(b) of the Act, any person who is lawfully
in possession of a drug specified in Schedule 2, 3, 4 or 5 which has been supplied by or on the

(4) It shall not by virtue of section 4(1)(b) or 5(1) of the Act be unlawful for any person in
respect of whom a licence has been granted and is in force under section 16(1) of the Wildlife and
Countryside Act 1981 M8 to supply, offer to supply or have in his possession any drug specified in
Schedule 2 or 3 for the purposes for which that licence was granted.
